dimensions.title: People & trust
dimensions.question: Would I recommend this team to a friend?
dimensions.legacyLabel: Team quality, retention and employee treatment
anchors: Credible, unresolved evidence of harmful management or employee treatment on the relevant team.
Repeated relevant concerns about churn, trust or manager behavior; explanations are weak.
Manager expectations and recent team history are acceptable, with specific concerns resolved.
Current and former colleagues corroborate supportive management, usable leave and internal growth.
Strong, recent team evidence from multiple perspectives, clear retention definitions and credible voluntary return or referral behavior.
dimensions.guidance: Ask why the last three people left, how missed goals are handled and whether respected former colleagues would return. Compare like-for-like turnover periods; overall turnover is not voluntary attrition.

dimensions.title: Role & growth
dimensions.question: Will I get better at work I actually care about?
anchors: The actual work, qualifications or mission conflicts with your goals or requirements.
Responsibilities are weakly aligned; ownership or learning is limited.
Core responsibilities fit, with a clear manager and acceptable learning opportunities.
The written role offers useful ownership, transferable skills and a believable growth path.
Exceptional match to your priorities, with concrete scope, resources, mentorship and evidence of internal progression.
dimensions.guidance: Use a real role and team, not a company slogan. Verify the reporting line, first six months, decision authority and what the last person moved on to.

dimensions.title: Business & runway
dimensions.question: Is this particular seat backed by a real plan?
anchors: Credible current evidence that the role is unfunded or the relevant business cannot sustain its commitments.
Concentrated financing, customer or program risk with an unclear funded plan.
A credible operating plan and approved headcount, with material risks understood.
Recent financial or customer evidence supports the team and its next milestone; downside scenarios have specific answers.
Resilient economics or appropriately financed milestones, credible customer demand and a clearly funded role through a plausible downside.
dimensions.guidance: For public firms, inspect the business unit and cash generation. For startups, distinguish primary equity, debt and secondary sales; ask about cash, burn and funded milestones. Famous investors alone do not earn points.

dimensions.title: Pay & benefits
dimensions.question: Does guaranteed cash support the life I want?
anchors: Written guaranteed compensation fails your non-negotiable floor or benefit needs.
Below matched-role alternatives or material benefit and repayment gaps.
Written base and usable benefits meet your floor and a reasonable matched-role comparison.
Competitive guaranteed pay and benefits versus comparable role, level and location offers.
An unusually strong documented package for the matched role, with valuable usable benefits and transparent terms.
dimensions.guidance: Separate base, target variable pay, public equity and private options. OTE is not base. Use matched roles and current benefit documents; do not compare an account executive with an engineer.

dimensions.title: Flexibility & life
dimensions.question: Can this job fit into my actual week?
anchors: The written office, eligibility, hours or travel requirements fail a hard constraint.
Frequent travel, rigid hours or office rules impose significant unwanted tradeoffs.
Job-specific location, days, hours and travel meet your requirements.
Written flexibility plus team practice gives you meaningful control and usable time off.
Excellent autonomy, predictable travel and sustainable working practices corroborated for the actual team and eligible location.
dimensions.guidance: Confirm legal work location, payroll country, office radius, exact weekdays, core hours, travel and offsites. Remote-first alone is not worldwide eligibility or low hours.

dimensions.title: Location & living
dimensions.question: What is left after living a real life?
anchors: A realistic household budget is infeasible on guaranteed cash.
After-tax cash, housing, care and commuting leave an unacceptably small buffer.
A realistic household budget leaves an acceptable buffer and workable commute.
Healthy monthly margin, manageable commute and a location you want to live in.
An unusually strong personal budget and lifestyle fit, including downside savings and relocation costs.
dimensions.guidance: Use household-specific taxes, housing, care, commuting and guaranteed pay. The atlas’s 2024 metro price index is context, not a current personal budget.
